_comment: Sky and fog keyframes keyed on planet pressure (Stage 2 slice 6). Source of every colour, fog fraction and the 0.66 sun scale: docs/art/planetary-keyframes.md 3.1 and 2.1 (Draft 2, Lead Artist; fluid). The hex values are the artist's ESTIMATES, not pixel samples of rover images (open item in that document). Schema: ARCHITECTURE.md 2.5.5. Colours are mixed in OKLab; pressure is interpolated on log10; outside the range the end keyframe holds. Fog start and end are fractions of the render distance (the end never drops below fog_end_floor_blocks).
_invented: dome_gradient_exponent (how fast the sky goes from horizon to zenith colour) and the use of one night colour for the whole dome are the implementer's choices; the Lead Artist reviewed both on 2026-11-27 and CONFIRMED them (docs/team/reports/2026-11-27-artist-sky-review.md), still invented values, not sourced; smoothing_s 30 is the artist's value (section 1.3).
_storm: AT-1 storm look and pre-storm haze, docs/art/atmosphere-plan.md 5.2 (Lead Artist). All values INVENTED estimates. mix: share of the target colour at full strength (OKLab); dim: linear-light loss at full strength; fog_end_target and fog_end_floor_blocks: the fog end (fraction of render distance, and a floor in blocks) at full strength; sun_alpha_min: sun alpha at full strength (plan 0.30; lowered to 0.10 because the SME note says the real 2018 storm sun was a pinprick, INVENTED); star_fade: share of star alpha lost at full strength; haze_*: the pre-storm haze (fog end cut and fog colour mix at haze 1); ramp_in_s and ramp_out_s: how fast the shown strength rises and falls (60 s in, 90 s out, planetary-keyframes 3.7); haze_window_sols: the haze rises over this long before onset (the server mirrors it in SkySync).
_fog_retune: AT-2 (atmosphere-plan 3): fog colour moved 70 % of the way to the horizon colour at every key, fog start earlier (0.50, 0.47, 0.42, 0.36, 0.30); fog end unchanged. INVENTED, checked by eye in a screenshot run and by the OKLab step test in SkyKeyframesTest.
